standard_footprint_review.frame: Unflipped KiCad footprint local component-side XY; body centre and locator centreline are origin; actuator exits +Y, solder-land row is -Y. A B-side native transform must be applied before choosing the final board edge.
standard_footprint_review.registered_y_derivation: PCB Mount - Hole Layout gives 4.0 mm from the hole centreline to the outer land edge and 2.50-mm land length: centre Y = -(4.0 - 2.50/2) = -2.75 mm
standard_footprint_review.engineering_land_difference: Pad centres, length, contact order and holes are unchanged. KiCad adds 0.025-mm land width on each side and rounds the corners with R0.25. This is a reviewed engineering land margin, not identical manufacturer artwork or proof of assembly solder quality.
standard_footprint_review.body_and_actuator_fab_review: F.Fab body is x[-4.5,4.5],y[-1.8,1.8]; side actuator reaches y3.8. The drawn actuator is one state, not the whole travel envelope; the courtyard also contains its 2.0-mm X travel and a 0.25-mm nominal margin.
